# Psalm 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-Asaph. The-Mighty-One, God, YHWH, speaks and-summons the-earth from-the-rising of-the-sun to-its-setting.

**2** From-Zion, the-perfection of-beauty, God shines-forth.

**3** Our-God comes and-does-not keep-silent; fire devours before-Him, and-around-Him it-storms greatly.

**4** He-summons the-heavens above and-the-earth, to-judge His-people:

**5** 'Gather to-Me My-faithful-ones, the-ones-cutting My-covenant over sacrifice.'

**6** And-the-heavens declare His-righteousness, for God — He [is] judge. Selah.

**7** 'Hear, My-people, and-I-will-speak; Israel, and-I-will-testify against-you: God, your-God, [am] I.

**8** Not for-your-sacrifices do-I-rebuke-you; and-your-burnt-offerings [are] before-Me continually.

**9** I-will-not take from-your-house a-bull, [nor] from-your-pens male-goats.

**10** For to-Me [belongs] every beast of-the-forest, the-cattle on a-thousand hills.

**11** I-know every bird of-the-mountains, and-the-creatures of-the-field [are] with-Me.

**12** If I-were-hungry, I-would-not tell you, for to-Me [belongs] the-world and-its-fullness.

**13** Do-I-eat the-flesh of-bulls, or drink the-blood of-male-goats?

**14** Sacrifice to-God thanksgiving, and-pay to-the-Most-High your-vows.

**15** And-call-upon-Me in-the-day of-distress; I-will-deliver-you, and-you-will-glorify-Me.'

**16** But-to-the-wicked God says, 'What [right have] you to-recount My-statutes, and-to-take My-covenant on-your-mouth?

**17** And-you — you-hate discipline, and-you-cast My-words behind-you.

**18** If you-see a-thief, you-are-pleased with-him, and-with adulterers [is] your-portion.

**19** Your-mouth you-send-forth in-evil, and-your-tongue frames deceit.

**20** You-sit, against-your-brother you-speak; against-the-son of-your-mother you-give a-report.

**21** These [things] you-did and-I-kept-silent; you-thought I-was altogether like-you. I-will-rebuke-you and-set [it] in-order before-your-eyes.

**22** Consider this, you-who-forget God, lest I-tear and-there-is-no deliverer.

**23** The-one-sacrificing thanksgiving honors-Me; and-the-one-ordering [his] way — I-will-show-him the-salvation of-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **50:10**: 'Cattle on a thousand hills' — the definitive statement of divine ownership. God doesn't need sacrifices because He already owns everything.

— EMET
